note: Rules derived from public ASU admission website. Individual course applicability is always determined by the college of your major after admission — this tool provides an estimate only.

eligibility_rules.repeated_courses: Only the first attempt with a C- or better is used
eligibility_rules.pass_grade: Transferable only if institution indicates P equals C- or better; not calculated into transfer GPA
eligibility_rules.older_coursework: Evaluated case-by-case; fast-changing fields (e.g. technology) may have limitations

community_college.label: Community College (2-year)
community_college.note: Maximum 64 semester hours accepted as lower-division credit from regionally accredited community, junior, or two-year colleges.
community_college.evaluation_note: Your college of major determines how transferred courses fulfill specific degree requirements. Work with an ASU academic advisor after admission.

direct_equivalency.description: Courses with a confirmed ASU equivalent via the Transfer Guide — counted toward specific degree requirements

general_elective.description: Courses that transfer as credit but without a specific ASU course equivalent — count toward total credit hours

not_transferable.description: Courses that do not transfer to ASU
examples: Remedial or developmental courses (typically numbered below 100)
Courses with a grade below C-

requires_evaluation.description: Courses that may transfer but need individual review by the college of your major
examples: Courses in fast-changing fields (technology, science) earned more than 10 years ago
Courses with non-standard credit units (quarter hours require conversion)
Military/JST credits (reviewed per VA guidelines and Arizona statutes)
Upper-division courses from community colleges (evaluated individually)

estimation_rules.note: These fractions are rough statistical estimates only. Actual applicability varies by major and is determined by your college advisor.

four_year_university.label: Four-Year University
four_year_university.note: Unlimited credit hours accepted from four-year regionally accredited institutions.
four_year_university.evaluation_note: Your college of major determines how transferred courses fulfill specific degree requirements. Work with an ASU academic advisor after admission.

direct_equivalency.description: Courses with a confirmed ASU equivalent via the Transfer Guide

general_elective.description: Courses that transfer as credit without a specific ASU equivalent

examples: Courses with a grade below C-
Courses in fast-changing fields earned more than 10 years ago

estimation_rules.note: These fractions are rough statistical estimates only. Actual applicability varies by major.
